description: This file defines a front-end component for the 'Home' page of a travel explorer application, using LightningJS components. It imports sub-components and a data-fetching function, and manages state including fetching and displaying destination data.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component serving as the main content for the homepage, orchestrating layout and data fetching.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: An asynchronous hook called when the component is ready, responsible for fetching destination data and updating the navigation bar and state.
